description: Defines data classes, enum, and response models related to API data for a TV app's frontend, including content items, banner responses, and home categories.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Domain model representing a content item displayed by the UI, including a title and optional poster URL.

classes.name: BannerResponse
classes.description: Model for the response from the /api/banner endpoint, containing a list of banner URLs.

classes.name: HomeCategory
classes.description: Enum of supported home categories with API path and display title.

methods.name: ContentItem
methods.description: Data class constructor for content item.

methods.name: BannerResponse
methods.description: Data class constructor for banner response.

methods.name: HomeCategory
methods.description: Enum entries representing different categories with associated API paths and titles.
